shellCommands.command: ls -la && echo "---PACKAGE---" && cat package.json && echo "---PAGES---" && find pages -type f 2>/dev/null && echo "---ALL SRC---" && find . -type f -not -path './node_modules/*' -not -path './.git/*' -not -path './.next/*' | head -50
ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>/dev/null && echo "---VERSION---" && cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'

echo "=== index.tsx ===" && cat pages/index.tsx && echo "=== about.tsx ===" && cat pages/about.tsx && echo "=== _app.tsx ===" && cat pages/_app.tsx && echo "=== _document.tsx ===" && cat pages/_document.tsx && echo "=== next.config.ts ===" && cat next.config.ts && echo "=== tsconfig ===" && cat tsconfig.json

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference && find . -name 'layout.md' -o -name 'page.md' -o -name 'link.md' | head && echo "---" && grep -rl -i "deprecat" 01-components/ file-conventions/ 2>/dev/null | head
cd /workspace && rm -rf pages && echo "pages removed" && ls

(npm start >/tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 6 && echo "=== / ===" && curl -s localhost:3000 | grep -o '[^<]*\|

[^<]*

\|href="/about"\|name="viewport"' | head && echo "=== /about ===" && curl -s localhost:3000/about | grep -o '[^<]*\|

[^<]*

\|href="/"' | head && pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; echo done
